reasons.claim: The notification is a 24.53 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Älvkarleby, status 'notified'. Completed felling overlaps only 3.9% of the polygon (0.965 ha), so this is not ALREADY_FELLED.

Pimpinella major (stor bockrot) is Red List EN. The tool counts it as eligible: forest-associated, felling-relevant (changed tree species composition) and site-bound. There are 23 records, the nearest at 0 m. Coordinate uncertainty is 5 m and the latest year is 2022. This matches the rubric HIGH rule (at least 1 eligible species within 250 m).

Recording effort is adequate: 3193 records within 1000 m against a county median of 113.5 (96th percentile). Within 250 m there are 26 records, 4 species and 3 observation days. The finding is not an artefact of a low-effort site.

contradictions.claim: Landscape context shows an EN ash (Fraxinus excelsior) record from 2023 that lies inside an area felled on 2026-09-29, 601 m away, so its habitat may be gone. This is context only and is not the eligible species driving HIGH. It shows that nearby felling has occurred.

uncertainties: The Pimpinella major records are from 2022. Whether the plants remain today is unknown.
The records may lie in the 0.9 ha 2026 partial felling or the 2023 partial felling that overlaps the polygon. I did not check this. Some of the habitat there may already be gone.
The tool lists only one felling-relevance factor for this species (changed tree species composition). It is a weaker link to felling than for dead-wood or old-forest species.
not_established: Whether Pimpinella major occurs in the stand to be felled today.
Forest character or stand age: the tools do not state it.
Whether felling is legal or harmful.
Absence of other species, including sensitive species hidden in public data.
next_action: A reviewer should map the 23 Pimpinella major records (GBIF links in E-22659) against the polygon and against the 2026 partial-felling area. Then they should decide whether a field check is needed before felling can begin.
